BUILD EVIDENCE
Official run:
https://github.com/clash-verge-rev/clash-verge-rev/actions/runs/29694732811
Read-only release logs for all four selected jobs explicitly record stable
v1.19.29, alpha-e26714a and service v2.3.3 being downloaded:
- Windows x64 regular installer: job 88213456261
- macOS Apple ARM: job 88213456267
- macOS Intel: job 88213456276
- Linux x64: job 88213456296
These are upstream build-log observations, not independent executable version
checks or reproducible-build verification. GitHub may expire the job logs.
GUI scripts/prebuild.mjs fetches latest stable/alpha/service artifacts at build
time; the immutable commits above and this historical build evidence must be
used instead of today's latest releases.

OTHER COMPONENTS AND COVERAGE
The source lockfiles and build scripts identify additional dependencies:
GUI Cargo.lock, pnpm-lock.yaml and scripts/prebuild.mjs; Mihomo go.mod/go.sum;
service Cargo.lock and its build workflow. Preserve each component's own
copyright/license notices. This directory is not an exhaustive SBOM or a
replacement for third-party notices embedded in the packages.

Build logs also show country.mmdb, geosite.dat and geoip.dat downloaded from
https://github.com/MetaCubeX/meta-rules-dat/releases/download/latest/
The exact historical data-release revision has not been recovered. Project
source/build and upstream dataset references are available at:
https://github.com/MetaCubeX/meta-rules-dat
Retain dataset notices in the upstream package; do not claim a complete
historical dataset-source mapping from this notice.

The regular Windows application installer has a link to Microsoft-direct
WebView2 Evergreen Standalone x64 runtime 153.0.4234.48 for offline installation
when the runtime is missing. Install the runtime companion first, then Clash.
It is separately licensed: see NOTICE.WebView2.txt and the complete offline
LICENSE.WebView2.txt (verbatim official HTML value: LICENSE.WebView2.html.txt).
GPL notices here do not cover Microsoft's runtime. The companion link is provided
only with this application, not as a stand-alone offering. Evergreen can check
for and install updates when online; offline installation does not disable
network features or updates. No recipient's agreement is asserted by these
files. Preserve Microsoft and supplier notices; no endorsement is implied.

SOURCE ACCESS AND REDISTRIBUTION
Only pinned release/source links and license notices are retained here;
no installers, package parts or mirrored source archives are included.
../../sources/manifest.json records source commits, official source URLs,
sizes and previously verified hashes. Additional references are in sources.json.
Anyone redistributing downloaded packages is responsible for complete
corresponding source access and applicable license/notice requirements.
These references do not claim complete dependency closure or a legal audit.
